what_it_does: OSRS Tracker is a RuneLite plugin that automatically captures gameplay events (level-ups, quest completions, loot drops, deaths, clue scrolls, collection log entries, item snitch bank scans, bingo progress) and POSTs them with screenshot/video clips to osrs-tracker.com via an authenticated Bearer-token API. This PR bumps a pinned dependency commit to ship Vulkan Video Encode (H.264) so eligible clients encode replay clips locally instead of streaming raw MJPEG frames to the backend, reducing bandwidth and server transcoding cost. UI changes surface a 'Vulkan encoding ready' / 'Vulkan't' status string driven by VideoRecorder.isVulkanEncoderActive().

unsafe_operations.what: Authenticated POSTs (Bearer apiToken) to configurable apiUrl (defaults to https://osrs-tracker.com) carrying gameplay events and base64 screenshot/video payloads.
Direct HTTP PUT of screenshot bytes to Backblaze B2 via presigned URL obtained from the Rails backend; URL is server-controlled but the upload path leaves runelite to a third-party storage host.
POST/GET to /api/bingo endpoints on the same configurable backend.
Reads user API token from RuneLite config (marked secret=true) and forwards as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Token never logged; standard pattern.

Reads OSRS_TRACKER_DEV and OSRS_TRACKER_API_URL environment variables to allow pointing the plugin at a non-production backend in dev mode. Gated on env var, so production users are unaffected, but it is an implicit override of the hardcoded production URL.

bottom_line: Low risk: PR is a client-side video-encoding optimization via a pinned dependency bump that aligns with the described intent; no reflection, subprocess, or new unsafe surface introduced in the visible code, and the only network traffic remains the plugin's documented event/screenshot uploads to its own backend.
